content.text: Fixed a real UX bug: double-clicking used to flash the color forward one step before snapping back to reset, because the `click` handler fired immediately while `dblclick` fired afterward. Now single clicks are briefly deferred (250ms) so a following double-click can cancel the pending step, giving a clean reset with no flash. Enter/Space activation and rapid multi-clicks (3+) are unaffected since they don't go through the delay path.
